There is no axis, no scale bar, no legend, no label in any language other than the English badge text, and no numeric value anywhere in the pixels. Because the image contains no materials-science data, it provides no information about the Fe–30Mn–9Al–C–3Ni selective-laser-melting study named in the paper title; it is almost certainly a stray web/download artefact captured in place of the intended figure. Nothing in the group is legible-data-bearing, so no scientific claim can be drawn from it.
